user.title: ZKSJ wave pump
user.description: The pump is controlled locally, without the Tuya cloud. You need its IP address, device id and local key — see the setup guide for how to read those once.

reconfigure.title: Update pump connection
reconfigure.description: Point Home Assistant at a new address, or replace a local key that changed after re-pairing.

error.cannot_connect: No reply from the pump on any Tuya protocol version. Check the IP address, device id and local key, and that nothing else holds the pump's local connection open.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while contacting the pump.

abort.already_configured: This pump is already set up.

feed.name: Feed mode
feed.description: Slows the pump for feeding. The pump runs the countdown itself and returns to its program.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long feed mode lasts, in seconds.

power.name: Flow
power.description: Flow to hold during feed mode, as a percentage.

set_program.name: Set program
set_program.description: Replaces the pump's whole daily program with a list of segments.

segments.name: Segments
segments.description: Segments, each with a wave type, a start and end time, and its flow, frequency and duty cycle.

sync_time.name: Sync clock
sync_time.description: Pushes Home Assistant's local time to the pump, so time-based programs run at the right hour.
